title: Miluna Acquisition Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Miluna Acquisition Corp (MMTXU), a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq, entered into a Business Combination Agreement on April 23, 2026 with Kukugan Invest (Parent) and CADV Ventures S.A. (Company), a Poland-based entity. The transaction involves a merger where Purchaser survives, with the Company becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary. Aggregate transaction consideration is $250,000,000, to be paid via issuance of PubCo Class A ordinary shares at $10.00 per share. The deal is expected to close in H2 2026.
